title: Share of the Pet Fee Returned, by Payment Plan
content:
# Payments operations note — share of the pet fee returned, by how the stay is paid

**Rule.** How much of the pet fee of a cancelled reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category is returned depends on how the stay is paid: on a stay paid in monthly installments whose collections have begun, the pet fee was collected in full up front, so the share returned is the pet-refundable nights divided by the stay's nights; on a pay-part-now stay whose balance has not been collected, the share returned is the pet-refundable nights divided by the stay's nights, times the deposit percentage of the stay's policy; on any other stay the share returned is the nightly amount refunded on the same cancellation divided by the stay's nightly subtotal.

The pet-refundable nights are the nights dated after the cancellation date and before the check-out date, less the nights the pet-fee refund leaves out for notice. Collections have begun when the stay's ledger shows at least one collection; the balance has been collected when the ledger shows the collection of installment 2.

## Deposit percentage by policy

| Policy | Pay-part-now deposit |
|---|---|
| Flexible | 50.00% |
| Moderate | 50.00% |
| Limited | 50.00% |
| Firm | 50.00% |
| Strict | 0.00% (plan not offered) |
| Super Strict 30 Days | 0.00% (plan not offered) |
| Super Strict 60 Days | 0.00% (plan not offered) |
| Long-Term | 0.00% (plan not offered) |

## Cases (hypothetical stays)

| Payment plan and ledger | Inputs | Share returned |
|---|---|---|
| monthly installments, installment 1 collected | 60 nights, 20 pet-refundable nights | 20 divided by 60, about 0.3333 |
| pay-part-now, balance not collected, 50.00% deposit | 10 nights, 6 pet-refundable nights | 6 divided by 10, times 50%, that is 0.30 |
| pay-part-now, balance collected | nightly subtotal 1,000.00, guest-cancellation nightly refund 400.00 | 0.40 |
| paid in full | nightly subtotal 1,000.00, guest-cancellation nightly refund 250.00 | 0.25 |
